author: Zintenka
body:
The successor to one of my biggest maps. This one is the same size give or take.


Features:
  • TNT
  • Enchanting
  • Blue vs Purple
  • 40 vs 40
  • A kill gives you 4 xp bottles and 4 pieces of bread
  • Special armor and very thorny lily pad found in a chest
Spawnkit:


(And this is a forewarning, to those of you who won't realize that the OP armor will have in total -60% speed then plz do not comment. I do not want to repeat myself a bajillion times.

Though i will answer constructive comments that give SUGGESTIONS.)

YML

Imgur

Download

"I will always make maps, and I shall continue to do so for this server."
 -Zintenka

-ChangleLog
  • Changed player count to 40 vs 40.
